{{C|Image depicts legs}} |designation=[[Sentience|Sentient]]{{StoryCite|story=Tooth and Claw|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} |class= |subspecies= |races= |height= |length= |wingspan= |mass= |skincolor= |haircolor= |feathers= |eyecolor= |distinctions=Stilt-like [[Limb|legs]]{{Film|IV}} |lifespan= |origin= |habitat= |diet= |language= }} The '''Quor'sav'''{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Alien Species in the Original Trilogy|video=yHVzcCGUM9U|nolive=1}} were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that moved about on at least two long, stilt-like [[Limb|legs]]. One such being was present in [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[1 BBY]]{{FilmDate|IV|1|the Quor'sav's appearence}} on the same [[Standard day|day]] [[Luke Skywalker]] sold [[X-34 landspeeder|his]] [[landspeeder]] to a [[Vuvrian]] named [[Wioslea]].''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' At some point prior to or during [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to [[3 ABY]]. As the ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' short story "[[Tooth and Claw]]" is set concurrently to the film, it must also take place in that [[Standard year|year]]. the [[Trandoshan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk]] assisted a Quor'sav narcotics agent on the astronomical object [[Uaua]]. When Bossk later confronted his sister [[Doshanalawook]] on the [[gunship]] ''[[Liswarr]]'', he noted that her [[projector console]] showed a detailed personal history of him, including a mention of the Quor'sav agent. ==Behind the scenes== The Quor'sav first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The species was first [[canon]]ically identified in the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' video "Every Alien Species in the Original Trilogy". In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[Bird/Legends|avian]] and [[monotreme]] characteristics first identified in the ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' base set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which was released in [[December]] [[1995]]. The cards also identified the owner of the legs seen in ''A New Hope'' as [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]].{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Kal'Falnl C'ndros}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=Tooth and Claw|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} {{C|Mentioned on screen}} ==Sources== *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Alien Species in the Original Trilogy|video=yHVzcCGUM9U|nolive=1}} {{1stID|Quor'sav}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=クオサヴ }} [[Category:Sentient species]]
